'''2014 US Nationals Day 2 Matthew Harrison-Trainor LS Republic At War''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] at [[2014 US Nationals]] (Day 2).

Typed printout (not a handwritten Xerox form).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Republic At War / Aggressive Negotiations]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
